description: $0.01 via x402: multi-source web & developer search in ONE call — Hacker News, GitHub, Stack Overflow and Wikipedia by keyword, returned as a unified ranked result set (titles, URLs, scores/stars, snippets). The research/search read agents make to ground answers, find code and gather context. No API keys, no per-source accounts.

sources.description: Comma list to narrow: hackernews,github,stackoverflow,wikipedia (default all)

x_payment.description: signed x402 payment payload (the X-PAYMENT header value) for the terms the first call returns; omit it to get the price and terms

name: web_search
